artefact: an exact-time ERA5 mean-sea-level-pressure acquisition and triangulation design for the fixed T4E.36 population
declared_by: Edward Jonathan Bentley, maintainer (scientific choice); drafted by Codex at the maintainer's direction and NOT VALID until the maintainer has reviewed and adopted it

why_this_exists.prior_commitment: The T4E.18 acquisition design states that mean sea level pressure is more commensurate with IBTrACS, and that MSLP is the next candidate if 850 hPa relative vorticity fails.
why_this_exists.new_evidence: T4E.36 failed after eastward support was added. T4E.37 then found that 12 of 13 condition-1 failures had no native-grid vorticity maximum inside the inherited agency radius before extractor thresholding, so tuning that threshold is not the dominant next explanation.
why_this_exists.question: Does a surface-pressure basin centre lie closer to the independent IBTrACS position than the corresponding 850 hPa vorticity-basin centre on a strict majority of the same 18 storm-times?

era5_single_levels.source: Copernicus Climate Data Store, ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present
era5_single_levels.grounding: The official product supplies hourly atmospheric single-level quantities on a regular 0.25 degree latitude-longitude grid.

ibtracs.source: NOAA NCEI IBTrACS v04r01 Technical Details
ibtracs.grounding: IBTrACS LAT and LON are combined best-track positions and WMO_PRES is minimum central pressure assigned by the responsible WMO agency; MSLP is therefore closer in measured quantity to that surface reference than 850 hPa relative vorticity.

frozen_population.source: Exactly the 18 T4E.36 raw-field rows, in their published order.
frozen_population.selection: Do not rerun the catalogue, select only failures or admit a wider storm population. Passing rows are controls for whether the comparison merely restates failure selection.
frozen_population.timestamps: Read the exact 18 sid/time identities from the content-bound T4E.36 receipt. Request no intervening frames.

single_level_request.why_exact_timestamp_shards: Only the fixed development rows are needed. Acquiring every synoptic frame from 2018-2021 would transfer 5844 frames to answer an 18-frame question and would expose data the declared diagnostic does not use.

wrapped_geometry.seam_rule: Verify the 180E/-180 MSLP samples within one measured source-encoding step per timestamp, retain the shared meridian once, and refuse mismatch or unmeasurable encoding.

frozen_centre_rule.catalogue_seed: Choose the native grid sample nearest the IBTrACS latitude/longitude by absolute coordinate distance, with lower array index resolving an exact tie.
frozen_centre_rule.mslp_centre: From the catalogue seed, repeatedly move to the lowest MSLP sample in the current 3x3 neighbourhood. Resolve equal values by shortest great-circle distance to the catalogue position, then lower row and column. Stop at a local minimum; refuse if the path reaches the outermost grid row or column or repeats.
frozen_centre_rule.vorticity_centre: Apply the sign-declared T4E.36 negation and, independently from the same catalogue seed, repeatedly move to the highest sample under the identical 3x3, tie and boundary rules.
frozen_centre_rule.why_basin_paths: A path seeded at the independent catalogue location associates one local centre without choosing a search radius, selecting the globally deepest system, or tuning against the observed offsets.
frozen_centre_rule.distances: Use catalogue_join.great_circle_km for catalogue-to-MSLP, catalogue-to-vorticity and MSLP-to-vorticity distances. No agency radius or new tolerance decides this comparison.

decision_declared_before_acquisition.VERTICAL_QUANTITY_SEPARATION_CANDIDATE: The catalogue-to-MSLP distance is strictly less than the catalogue-to-vorticity distance for that row.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.CATALOGUE_REANALYSIS_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE: The catalogue-to-MSLP distance is strictly greater than the catalogue-to-vorticity distance for that row.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.EXACT_TIE: The two distances are exactly equal; report separately and do not award either side.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.VERTICAL_QUANTITY_SEPARATION_DOMINANT: At least 10 of all 18 fixed rows are VERTICAL_QUANTITY_SEPARATION_CANDIDATE.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.CATALOGUE_REANALYSIS_ALIGNMENT_DOMINANT: At least 10 of all 18 fixed rows are CATALOGUE_REANALYSIS_ALIGNMENT_CANDIDATE.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.MIXED: Neither candidate reaches 10 of all 18 rows.
decision_declared_before_acquisition.no_acceptance: Every outcome carries VERDICT NOT_AN_ACCEPTANCE and cannot rescue T4E.36 or T4E.8.

execution_boundary.planning: Offline validation may read only the two content-bound measurement receipts and must report network_used false.
execution_boundary.acquisition: Requires a current digest-bound human adoption, a T4E.38-specific explicit network authorisation, the general SPECTRALEARTH_ALLOW_NETWORK gate, and standard CDS credentials.
execution_boundary.later_phases: Materialisation and evaluation remain a successor implementation slice. This declaration freezes their geometry and decision before any MSLP value is acquired.

claim_boundary: The future result can compare deterministic ERA5 MSLP-basin and 850 hPa vorticity-basin centres relative to the fixed independent IBTrACS positions. It cannot identify either basin centre as the cyclone, prove vertical tilt or pressure-level/surface separation, establish independence between ERA5 and assimilated observations, validate the catalogue or extractor, approve a tolerance or mining radius, rescue T4E.36, demonstrate recurrence, or make an atmospheric claim.
